instruments.notes: Two swap transactions combined; weighted average fixed price. Company pays 50% of the difference if market is above $2.15 and receives 100% if below. Market price based on Inside F.E.R.C.'s Gas Market Report (Henry Hub or Houston Ship Channel). Fair value of all price swap agreements combined was $806 thousand (carrying value $57 thousand), not split by instrument.
instruments.evidence_quote:
For the period January 1995 through March 1995, American has two swap transactions
covering 15,000 MMBtu of gas per day hedged at a weighted average fixed price of
$2.15 per MMBtu.

instruments.notes: Text describes 362,000 barrels hedged at a floor of $17.96 per Bbl NYMEX WTI Light Crude Oil, disclosed within the swap agreements note; carrying value reflects a premium paid. Floor classified as put_option based on the word floor only.

the period January 1995 through June 1995, the Company has 362,000 barrels of oil

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Swap agreements used to mitigate impact of oil and gas price declines; about 41% of Dec 1994 oil production hedged through June 1995 and 23% of gas through March 1995.
